BiblicalUsage: Hôwy is the cry of grief, the word the prophets cry when judgment falls. In 1 Kings 13:30, the text says "Alas, my brother!" over the man of God laid in his grave.
TheologicalSignificance: This word, hôwy, does its job quietly — alas, woe — and I leave it at that.
